what: Artifacts whose dependency on a module is limited to SPECIFIC SYMBOLS, with the hash of each symbol's source at the time the artifact was last verified.
why: check_artifact_freshness.py compares FILE mtimes. That is right almost always and wrong here: ablation.py imports seven functions from eval_unified.py, and editing an UNRELATED part of that file (adding load_and_encode, changing an argparse default) marked three ablation artifacts stale. Regenerating them means 23 training runs — 3 seeds plus 10 plus 10 — for a change that provably cannot affect them. A gate that is permanently red for a reason everyone knows is false trains its reader to ignore it, which is the failure this repo keeps correcting.
how: If every declared symbol still hashes to the recorded value, the mtime difference is ignored. If ANY differs, the artifact is STALE and must be regenerated — the escape hatch cannot outlive the code it was granted against.
